case_number: 2025 INSC 296; PETITION FOR SPECIAL LEAVE TO APPEAL (C) NO. 4330 OF 2025
summary: Arbitration agreement enforceable post-death; legal heirs bound despite non-signatory status; Ravi Prakash Goel precedent applied; Section 40 Arbitration Act, 1996 sustains arbitration rights; dispute over partnership dissolution and accounts referable to arbitration; clause 15 partnership deed covers heirs; impugned judgment set aside; referral to arbitration upheld.
final_judgment: Petition allowed; impugned judgment of Gauhati High Court set aside; matter referred to arbitration as per partnership deed.
